interface.longDescription:
Slates is a desktop AI video studio you buy once and keep. This plugin connects your AI to it, so your AI can run the whole production with you. It writes the script, builds characters and storyboards, shows you the price before anything generates, makes the images and video, and lays the cut out on the timeline, ready to export to DaVinci Resolve or Premiere. Every project and file stays on your own computer.

You need the Slates desktop app on Windows or macOS and a Slates account with credits. If the app isn't set up yet, the plugin walks you through installing and connecting it, then hands the work to the Slates tools.
